mapper.select: SELECT bno, btitle, bcontent, bdate, bview, bip, mno FROM board ORDER BY bno DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( bno, btitle, bcontent, bimage, bdate, bview, bip, mno ) VALUES ( board_seq.NEXTVAL, #{btitle}, #{bcontent}, #{bimage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 0, #{bip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mno})
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET btitle = #{btitle}, bcontent = #{bcontent}, bip = #{bip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, bimage = #{bimage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE bno = #{bno}
